wikipediaSummary.title: All the Young Dudes (album)
wikipediaSummary.description: 1972 studio album by Mott the Hoople
wikipediaSummary.extract: All the Young Dudes is the fifth studio album by the English rock band Mott the Hoople, released in 1972. It was their initial album for the CBS Records label, after three years with Island Records in the UK and Atlantic Records in the United States and Canada.
